verdict.line: You lose if you eat a full Q-E combo standing in melee range before level 6; you win if you survive to two items and force extended duels with R (Realm of Death).

brief.thesis: Aatrox out-ranges and out-sustains you with Q (The Darkin Blade) chains and W (Infernal Chains) resets, so the 49.4% head-to-head over 621 games reflects a lane where he dictates the all-in timing, not a lane you're outclassed in — Morde's answer is denying his healing with Thornmail/Bramble Vest and closing the gap with item power rather than trying to out-trade him in isolated exchanges.

theirWindow.what: This is his chain-combo all-in window — Q1 knockup/slow into Q2 (and a possible Q3 reset) plus E dash-in. Do not stand still to trade autos here; this is exactly the Q-E combo OP.GG's own tip warns about, so back off or pre-emptively E (Death's Grasp) him to interrupt the chain.

yourWindow.when: his W (Infernal Chains) whiffs or E is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: He loses his gap-close/root and can't reposition — walk him down with Q (Obliterate) into W (Siphon of Destruction) and commit to the extended trade, since without E he can't disengage from your sustained damage.

powerCurve.note: Q maxed first, chain all-in online
World Ender spike outscales your early R

start.why: Runs 50.7% over 152 games — the flat damage reduction and regen directly blunt Aatrox's Q poke and the passive punishes his early auto-trades, which matters more here than the Doran's Ring mana sustain since you're not winning a poke war.

boots.why: 50.3% over 582 games and 82.8% pick — Aatrox's damage in extended trades leans heavily on auto-attacks between ability casts, so the flat AA reduction outperforms tenacity here.

core.why: Slow on every ability lets you kite his E dash-ins and keeps him inside W (Siphon of Destruction) and E (Death's Grasp) range instead of letting him reset neutral.
The omnivamp lets you win extended trades even after he's landed his combo, and the true damage ramp closes the duel-power gap he has pre-6.
Best measured path here at 68.8% over 16 games — the grievous wounds directly shuts down his W lifesteal and R sustain, which is the actual reason he wins extended fights.

situational.when: he's out-healing your trades before you can finish Thornmail — this is the item OP.GG flags for exactly this reason
the game goes long and you need more burn DPS instead of another defensive stat stick
you need the grievous wounds online faster than a full Thornmail build allows
his W (Infernal Chains) root is landing consistently and the tenacity matters more than the AA reduction

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive damage and healing on full stacks (5 hits) rewards exactly the extended-trade style this matchup demands — you're not winning quick pokes, you're winning the 4-5 second all-in once stacks are up.

summoners.why: 49.1% win rate at 87% pick — Ignite denies the healing from his W lifesteal and R sustain during the level 1-5 window before Thornmail is up, and Flash is your only way to escape a landed Q-E combo since Morde has no dash.

playing.title: Track Q charge count constantly
playing.detail: Two or three stacked charges means his chain all-in is live. Disengage or force him to use E first before you commit to a trade.

playing.title: Punish whiffed W chains
playing.detail: If Infernal Chains misses, immediately walk in with Q into W — he has no follow-up mobility until E comes back.

playing.title: Don't fight into his level 6 spike
playing.detail: World Ender gives him sustain, movement speed, and AD that outscales your early R (Realm of Death). Play for CS from level 6-8, not skirmishes.

playing.title: Rush grievous wounds components
playing.detail: Bramble Vest into Thornmail is the single biggest lever in this matchup — it directly negates the healing that lets him win extended fights.

playing.title: Freeze the wave pre-6
playing.detail: Aatrox wants a pushed wave to E in and combo you near his minions. Freezing near your tower removes his engage range.

playing.title: Use R to isolate him in skirmishes
playing.detail: Realm of Death cuts him off from ally peel and vision — once you're two items deep this is where you flip fights he'd otherwise win.

playing.title: Bait E before all-inning
playing.detail: Poke with W (Siphon of Destruction) from max range to force an E dash-in on cooldown, then commit your all-in.

brief.patchCaveat: The build paths, win rates, and pick rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the tell, power curve, and trade-pattern reasoning are my own tactical read of the matchup, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Aatrox’s (Q)-(E) combo when fighting him. Purchase Bramble Vest to gain the upper hand when fighting him.
